basic_profile.bio: A passionate gamer and tech enthusiast hailing from Seattle, WA. I have a deep love for the Halo series and enjoy discussing game mechanics and updates with fellow fans. During the day, I work as a software engineer, which gives me a keen interest in technology-related subreddits. I'm usually online during evenings and weekends when I'm not exploring the Pacific Northwest or engaged in a co-op game with my partner. I'm in a long-term relationship and enjoy spending time with my two cats.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My expertise spans software development and network security. I've taught myself a lot about gaming graphics and design, especially in relation to the Halo franchise.
